description: Per-driver averages are computed over standings records with points strictly greater than 1.0, leaving out records at exactly 1.0.

c.request: Split driver standings records by their season-to-date points total (`driverStandings.points`), using 1.0 points as the dividing line, and keep only the records on the higher side. From those kept records, compute for each driver (`driverId`) the average season-to-date points and the average season-to-date wins (`wins`), ignoring missing values. Then take the mean of those per-driver average wins across all drivers (ignoring missing values), and proceed only if that mean exists. For each driver, show the driver ID, the average points, the average wins, and the driver's average wins minus that overall mean. Return the 10 drivers with the largest difference, largest first, with missing differences last, unrounded. Per-driver averages are computed over standings records with points strictly greater than 1.0, leaving out records at exactly 1.0.
c.sql: WITH per AS (SELECT driverId, AVG(points) AS avg_points, AVG(wins) AS avg_wins FROM driverStandings WHERE points > 1.0 GROUP BY driverId), m AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS mean_wins FROM per) SELECT p.driverId, p.avg_points, p.avg_wins, p.avg_wins - m.mean_wins AS diff FROM per p CROSS JOIN m WHERE m.mean_wins IS NOT NULL ORDER BY diff DESC LIMIT 10

a.request: Using only driver standings records whose season-to-date points total (`driverStandings.points`) is more than 1.0, compute for each driver (`driverId`) the average season-to-date points and the average season-to-date wins (`wins`), ignoring missing values. Then take the mean of those per-driver average wins across all drivers (ignoring missing values), and proceed only if that mean exists. For each driver, show the driver ID, the average points, the average wins, and the driver's average wins minus that overall mean. Return the 10 drivers with the largest difference, largest first, with missing differences last, unrounded.
a.sql: WITH per AS (SELECT driverId, AVG(points) AS avg_points, AVG(wins) AS avg_wins FROM driverStandings WHERE points > 1.0 GROUP BY driverId), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS mean_wins FROM per) SELECT p.driverId, p.avg_points, p.avg_wins, p.avg_wins - o.mean_wins AS diff FROM per p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE o.mean_wins IS NOT NULL ORDER BY diff DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

d.request: Among driverStandings records with points strictly greater than 1.0 (excluding those at exactly 1.0), compute each driver's average points and average wins (ignoring NULLs), take the mean of those per-driver average wins across all drivers (proceeding only if it is non-null), and return the 10 drivers with the largest (driver average wins minus overall mean), largest first, NULL differences last, unrounded, showing driverId, average points, average wins, and the difference.
d.sql: WITH d AS (SELECT driverId, AVG(points) AS avg_points, AVG(wins) AS avg_wins FROM driverStandings WHERE points > 1.0 GROUP BY driverId), m AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS mean_wins FROM d) SELECT d.driverId, d.avg_points, d.avg_wins, d.avg_wins - m.mean_wins AS diff FROM d CROSS JOIN m WHERE m.mean_wins IS NOT NULL ORDER BY diff DESC, d.driverId LIMIT 10

b.request: Using only driver standings records with season-to-date points strictly greater than 1.0 (excluding records at exactly 1.0), compute per driverId the average points and average wins (ignoring NULLs), then the mean of those per-driver average wins across all drivers (ignoring NULLs, proceeding only if it exists), and return the top 10 drivers by (driver's average wins minus that overall mean) descending with NULL differences last, showing driverId, average points, average wins, and the unrounded difference.
b.sql: WITH per AS (SELECT driverId, AVG(points) AS avg_points, AVG(wins) AS avg_wins FROM driverStandings WHERE points > 1.0 GROUP BY driverId), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS mean_wins FROM per) SELECT p.driverId, p.avg_points, p.avg_wins, p.avg_wins - o.mean_wins AS diff FROM per p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE o.mean_wins IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (p.avg_wins - o.mean_wins) IS NULL, (p.avg_wins - o.mean_wins) DESC LIMIT 10
